title: Sherpa-UI workflow definition
description: One workflow, as JSON: its nodes, their values, and the connections between their sockets. A node's data comes in on its header, of any type, and leaves from its Rows row ("node/rows"); a test's True is its row "node/true", and only a Check node branches, by "node/yes" and "node/no". What each node IS comes from its kind. checkWorkflow() reads it; readWorkflow() reads a v1 as one. docs/history/plan-713-node-model.md

id.description: The workflow's id: its row in the store, and its draft, are filed under it.

connections.description: A top graph's: none starts at a Group Input or ends at a Group Output.
